note: Synthetic networks (Braess, grids) carry the primary study. One real network, TNTP Sioux Falls, is used locally for calibration and a second test (owner approval 2026-11-24, round 2; decision D-010). It is never committed or redistributed: only the download script, URL, licence, SHA-256, sizes and access date are recorded here.

synthetic.description: Four-node Braess network with linear link costs 10x, x+50, x+50, 10x and optional link x+10; demand 6.
synthetic.provenance: Cost functions and demand re-entered from Braess, Nagurney and Wakolbinger (2005), doi:10.1287/trsc.1050.0127, and https://supernet.isenberg.umass.edu/facts/braess.html (both opened 2026-11-24). No file copied.
synthetic.licence: Mathematical example; FLOW encoding under LicenseRef-FLOW-NC-Research-1.0

synthetic.description: Seeded n-by-n bidirectional grids with BPR costs and Dirichlet-weighted OD demand.
synthetic.provenance: Generated by FLOW code; parameters in research/protocol.md section 11.
